body.p: The woman Chuwukchak is sleeping. The first one came to Chuwukchak, she started waking up the sleeping one. The first one started singing: "Chuwukchak! Chuwukchak! Why are you sleeping? There are dead people around, there are dead people farther away, birds started twittering, birds started twittering!" "First one, first one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't, I won't, I won't seat you, the second one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a round dance, I am shamanized". "Second one, second one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't, I won't, I won't seat you, the third one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a circle, I am shamanized". "Third one, third one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't, I won't, the fourth one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a circle, I am shamanized". "Fourth one, fourth one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't seat [you], the fifth one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a circle, I am shamanized". "Fifth one, fifth one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't seat [you], the sixth one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a circle, I am shamanized". "Sixth one, sixth one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't seat [you], the seventh one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a circle, I am shamanized". "Seventh one, seventh one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't seat [you], the eighth one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a circle, I am shamanized". "Eighth one, eighth one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't seat [you]! The ninth one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a circle, I am shamanized". Ninth one, ninth one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". "I won't seat [you], [DCh]: Not clear why the tenth one shall try! I am surrounded by Muriwul's shaman coat, I am surrounded by a circle, I am shamanized". accusative case here. "Tenth one, tenth one! Seat me on the container for blankets, on the container for kettles". The tenth one seated [her], they went off to Muriwul. She went through the yurt, she went off. Muriwul stayed back alone in his small yurt. He went off, he went along their traces. There she caught up the first one, he said: "Woman, look back". "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back, throw the leather wrinkler". Muriwul threw the leather wrinkler, he missed [her]. Then he went again, he went and caught up the second one. "Second one, look back!" "I won't, I don 't see with the eyes, with what do I look back? Throw a scraper, where do you catch up mother Tenth?" Muriwul threw, he missed [her], he went off, again he caught a woman, the third one. "Woman, look back!" "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back, throw a scraper". Muriwul threw for the third time, he missed [her], he went off again, he passed by, again he caught up a woman. "Woman, look back!" "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back? Throw a scraper". He threw quickly, missed [her], he went off again, he caught up a woman again, the fifth one. "Woman, look back". "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back, where do you catch up mother Tenth; throw a detail of the tambourine". Muriwul threw the detail of the tambourine, he missed [her]. He went off, again he caught up a woman, the sixth one. "Woman, look back". "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back? Throw the handle [of the tambourine]". He threw, missed [her], he let the handle, he went off, again he caught up a woman, the seventh one. "Woman, look back". "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back, throw the sun [= the bladder of the tambourine]". Muriwul threw, he missed [her], he went on, he caught up a woman. "Woman, look back". "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back, throw the circle [of the shaman cap]!" He threw, he missed [her], he went off, he caught up a woman, he said: "Woman, look back". "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back, throw the cover of the tambourine". He threw, he missed [her], he went off, he caught up a woman: "Woman, look back". "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back, throw the shaman horn". Muriwul threw, he missed [her], he went off, he caught up a woman. "Woman, look back". "I won't, I don't see with the eyes, with what do I look back, throw the shaman coat". He threw, he missed [her]. Muriwul went off, he met a man. He hid. Seeing Muriwul the man said: "A-ha-ha-ha!" The ogre came to Muriwul, he carried a knapsack, the human said to Muriwul: "Let's hide from each other!" The ogre went off. Muriwul said: "How will we hide from each other?" The ogre went off. Muriwul broke a willow, he held it and went off, he hit at the water, where [that one] had dove. There the ogre stood up: "A-ha-ha-ha! Man, you are stronger!" The ogre hid again, Muriwul watched: The ogre turned into a tree stump. Muriwul went off, again he broke a willow, he came to the tree stump, he hit with the willow. The human said: "A-ha-ha-ha, man, you are stronger". Then the ogre said: "Well, man, now you go to hide". Muriwul said: "But you don' t look". Muriwul went and went, there he turned into a butterfly, he crawled into a crack in dead wood. The ogre searched and searched, he couldn't find him. In the evening the ogre overnighted. He overnighted close to the dead wood. He lit a fire, he fried a wood grouse. Suddenly [somebody] was singing: "As if a man would say, he would eat something, he was hungry for bear", the man said and carried the wood grouse in his knapsack. "Where the man has disappeared, [there are] only stars?" He lay down to sleep; having lain down, he warmed his back at the place for the night [at the fire]. Warming himself, Muriwul shot into his back, he said: "Dead wood, what are you doing, what are you doing, stop!" He shot again, the ogre died. Muriwul crawled out of the dead wood, he turned into a human and went off. There a black grouse was flying, it landed there. Muriwul shot [it], he killed the black grouse. He came there, he caught it. The black grouse asked and said: "Man, how did you do?" The man said: "I shot". "It hit exactly my breast". The man started to pluck it, the black grouse said: "Man, what are you doing?" "I am plucking [you]". "What else", it said, "it hurts". The man plucked [it], he lit a fire, chopped a tree, the black grouse said: "What are you doing? What did sting?" The man lit the fire, started to flay [the black grouse], the black grouse said: "Man, what are you doing?" "I am cutting". The black grouse burst(?). "What else, I say, with what does one warm the back?" The man [GVY:] Meaning unclear.roasted [it], that one asked: "Man, what are you doing?" Muriwul said: "I am spit-roasting [you]". "What else, why does it shrivel?" Muriwul eats the black grouse. He started eating, the black grouse said: "Man, what are you doing?" "I am eating". "What else, what does it turn dark?" Muriwul defecated. Muriwul's excrements said: "Toninya, Toninya, you didn't kill me". Muriwul shot at his excrements, the arrow got stuck. He shot again, again the arrow got stuck. He hit with his bow, his excrements said: "Toninya, Toninya, you didn't kill me". The excrements grabbed his foot, it said again: "Toninya, Toninya, you didn't kill me". He grabbed the other [foot], both feet, again it said: "Toninya, Toninya, you didn't kill me". Muriwul hit with his hand, the hand got stuck. His excrements said: "Toninya, Toninya, you didn't kill me". The excrements grabbed both his hands. "Toninya, Toninya, you didn't kill me". It grabbed the whole head. And so it was [with Muriwul]. The ogre came and said: "Ohoho! The prey is well frozen!" He put Muriwul into the knapsack and carried [him]. Then Muriwul said: "Grandfather, take a rest on the stones". The ogre started resting on the stones. Muriwul started putting stones [into the knapsack]. Muriwul put [in] stones. The ogre went on. Muriwul said: "Grandfather, go to the fallen tree". He went to the fallen tree, Muriwul grabbed the tree with his hands, there he stayed. The ogre came home. At home he said: "Wife, [it is] heavy prey at all". The old woman jumped there, out of joy she swallowed a thimble, she took the knapsack, she looked, [there are] only stones, she asked the ogre: "Did you swallow [the prey]?" He stabbed her belly, [there is] nothing, only the thimble, the ogre said: "Tisholo, Tisholo, the belly is torn". He smeared it with blood, the belly got fine. The ogre went back along his traces, he found Muriwul, who was clutching at the fallen tree. That one said: "E-he-he-he, the prey has clutched after overnighting". Then he put him in the knapsack, he carried him home. He carried him, he brought him there, he hung up the frozen prey on the horizontal pole. His child said: "Mummy, cut off an auricle for me". The mother looked askance, the father said: "A-ha-ha-ha, the frozen one shall look askance!" Muriwul peed, the ogre said: "Wife, to the sea, to the sea!" They went off, they went eating. Muriwul said to the children: "Let me! I make crossbows for you, use me as a bullet". How he has said, they untied [him]. There Muriwul chopped off their heads. He cooked their bodies. He put their heads onto the blankets [as if] they were sleeping. The parents came, they said: "Are our little ones untied, their lips are soiled". Then they started to eat. "What, old woman, aren't they our children, the man has cooked my children". "How, it can't [be] your child", they examined the children, [there] are only their heads. They lay down, the started to cry. Muriwul is lying under the bed, he stabbed the ogres with an awl. The ogres said: "What is stabbing there in our sides, [probably] because of the sorrow about the children". Both ogres died. When they had died, Muriwul went off. There he found the yurt of Ewenks. He started searching [in the yurt], he found an iron spoon, then he started searching again, he found a tool for smearing, he said: "Shem, shem, shem, I found a paddle". The he started searching again, he found a needle. "Shem, shem, shem, I found a peavey!" Then he started searchin again, he found excrements of a dog. "Shem, shem, I found dried meat!" He went again, he met neighbours, a small bird and a jay are living together. One [of them] said: "With what do we feed the man?" Muriwul said: "In the prow of the boat there was dried meat". The woman went off, she went searching. She could not find it, she was searching and searching, she did not find. The second one went off, searched and searched, she also did not find anything, she said: "Mummy, there is no dried meat!" Muriwul said: "Shiw, shiw, shiw, what kind of dried meat is there, shiw, shiw, shiw!" Muriwul turned into a mouse. He crawled under the bed. They started to beat [him] with the leather wrinkler, they broke the leather wrinkler. Then [GVY:] she took the scraper, the scraper broke, she took another scraper, the scraper broke. There Muriwul turned into a The second part of the sentence is unclear.mouse, and now he is a mouse.
